purpose: Characterize every ApplicationShell field, method, action, authority, and lifecycle edge before extraction; this contract assigns ownership but does not create a second implementation.

owners.responsibility: Process composition root and sole default GLib main-context/main-loop scheduling authority; owns the single process-wide authenticated Agent IPC transport plus startup, cross-window routing, transfer, and shutdown ordering around each window shell.
Window composition root, sole live WorkspaceState, top-level GTK window ownership, UI projection, and delegation between focused coordinators.
The sole bounded configuration reader and safe writer: resolves the XDG path, validates without logging contents, and preserves operator-owned TOML while persisting product changes.
The sole process last-good configuration and parent-directory observation authority; owns debounce and publication decisions while ApplicationCoordinator projects accepted snapshots to every window.
One GTK action registry, typed Variant decoding, command availability, shortcuts, and dispatch without product-state ownership.

The sole window-local shortcut registry and capture-phase dispatcher, plus its focused Shortcuts settings projection; source command IDs and persisted overrides remain owned by the core shortcut model and ConfigStore.

The sole nonmodal GTK settings shell, source-section navigation/history policy, Appearance projection, and Notifications projection. Theme discovery is a bounded, read-only projection; notification delivery uses the standard session-bus service without owning terminal-attention policy; all durable settings writes and native reload authority remain in ConfigStore and ApplicationShell.
The sole pane-to-Ghostty-surface projection, including launch-deferred pane identity, callback registrations, transactional construction, focus, child exit, and teardown.
The sole UI-thread drain of authenticated agent events, enrichment generations, cancellation, and projection through the core reducer.
The sole window-local bridge from pure Global Find policy to existing Ghostty search sessions, GLib debounce, exact workspace selection, and numeric GTK projection.

The sole window-local projection from each Ghostty surface foreground process through bounded Linux process-tree inspection to transient SSH identity; owns one cancellable GLib polling source, at most one GLib/GIO blocking-pool probe, and no persistence or reconnection policy.

The sole window-local bridge from real GTK file/image clipboard and drop gestures to transactional remote transfer, SSH identity revalidation, cancellation, progress projection, and verified path insertion.
The sole window-local bridge from a Ghostty-owned selection through pure Zentty formatting policy to the standard GTK clipboard; selection bytes are never persisted or logged.
One launch/live/shutdown snapshot lifecycle and one ordered persistence worker around the existing SessionRestoreStore and SnapshotPersistence implementation.
Window-local sidebar, pane-layout, accessible divider handles, peek, palette, search, navigation, rendering, and geometry projection pending final wiring review.
The already extracted bridge from the pure tmux compatibility model to the single product workspace and pane runtime, plus the one locked XDG file policy for source-compatible durable tmux state.

The sole window-local development-server registry, browser catalog, and bounded Linux listener/container observer; projects source-ranked servers and explicit browser targets into existing actions, launches normalized URLs without a shell, and revalidates ownership before signaling.

The sole window-local task snapshot and launch bridge; discovers bounded source tasks for the focused pane, projects them into the existing command palette, revalidates activation, and transactionally launches through the existing workspace and Ghostty runtime.

The sole window-local Git, pull-request, and project-icon context projection; resolves bounded real repository state and canonically contained project icons for pane working directories, applies adaptive refresh without overlapping probes, rejects stale observations, preserves same-reference stale review evidence on transient failure, and launches only validated remote URLs.

The sole window-local Open With catalog and launch boundary; discovers real Linux desktop applications and executable targets once, resolves the focused canonical local directory or a revalidated product-owned source file, and launches through GIO or direct argv without a shell.

The sole window-local bookmark/preset bridge: captures the existing live WorkspaceState and Ghostty foreground process, persists one bounded XDG store, restores through the existing pane runtime with fresh identities, and owns the source GTK popover, editing, linkage, import/export, recency, and visible fallback diagnostics.

existing SessionRestoreStore, real private filesystem, real interrupted child writer, delivered product relaunch
